ideas.title: Abuse of Power within ICE
ideas.description: This story would investigate allegations of abuse of power and negligence within ICE, including the recent arrest that resulted in skull fractures
questions: What are the allegations of abuse of power within ICE?
How has ICE responded to these allegations?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a pattern of abuse of power within ICE and to hold those responsible accountable. It requires careful investigation and analysis of evidence to determine the extent of these abuses.
